lines.text: Dust, noise, vibration, and hazardous substances.
Some of our activities create dust, noise, and vibration.
And we may use products such as fuels, oils, cement, resins, and other chemicals.
You must follow the relevant COSHH assessment, and use the required control measures.
Where dust is generated, suitable extraction or suppression must be used.
Respiratory protection must be suitable for the task, and tight-fitting masks require face-fit testing.
Exposure to noisy equipment and vibrating tools must be controlled.
Wet concrete and cement can cause serious chemical burns, so suitable gloves, footwear, and washing arrangements are essential.
Do not use chemicals or unfamiliar products without the necessary information and instruction.
Control the dust. Protect your lungs, ears, and skin. Know what you're using.
